text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the start of the new year, Kitasan
Black
enters her classic year, a very
important period
for an Umamusume's
racing career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to come up with concrete
goals if we
hope to make great strides
this year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle, rattle, rattle!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer! There's no
time to
waste! Let's come up with some
New Year's
resolutions right away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't say I'm surprised by how proactive
Kitasan
Black is. If there's one thing she's
always got an
abundance of, it's the
determination to keep
improving.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right then, let's get going! We're going
to visit
my home!

text_block_list.name: Apprentices
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Master!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly find myself dragged to a New
Year's
party at Kitasan Black's home.
Upon arriving, her
father's top
apprentice comes to greet us.

text_block_list.name: Top Apprentice
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Miss Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year to you too. This is my
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We're here today to declare our New
Year's
resolution to Dad!

text_block_list.name: Top Apprentice
text_block_list.text: Hm, I see... In that case, instead of simply stating your resolution...

text_block_list.name: Top Apprentice
text_block_list.text: Why don't you demonstrate to us just how passionate you are by singing together?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A duet with Trainer?! I don't know how I
feel
about singing in front of Dad and all
of you...
That's pretty nerve-racking.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But I do wanna pour my heart and wishes
into a
song! What do you think, Trainer?
Are you on
board with me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The prospect of singing in front of
professional
singers is terrifying, but I
muster up the courage
and consign
myself to performing with her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hm, which one do you think we should
do,
Trainer? This one? Or this one? Or
maybe this
one?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black suggests three options for
me to
pick from. I decide to go with...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Gone in a Flash", huh? You chose an
interesting
one! Let's go with this, then!
choice_data_list: お父さんの曲、1時間メドレー
choice_data_list_en: A one-hour medley of your dad's songs.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The day we met, you and I shared
glances. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Then you leeeft! Aaah! The person I
loved was
gone in a flash! ♪
choice_data_list_en: No time~ to fall in love~♪

text_block_list.name: Top Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You two were in perfect harmony
with each
other.

text_block_list.name: Top Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Only a true speedster can disappear in a
flash like
that. Do your best to show
your father the same
speed in your races
this year!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Will do! And that's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's sprint through this year so
fast, no
one can even see me coming!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black makes a promise for the
upcoming
year, swearing that she'll
sprint past her foes and
leave them all in
the dust!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a one-hour medley of my dad's
songs! Great
choice!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I can sing every song from
memory!
Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, after an hour of passionate
singing...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That felt great! Thank you all for
listening!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Top Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You both have incredible stamina!
It's
astounding that you were able to
sing through
every last song.

text_block_list.name: Top Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
I think that proves you won't have
trouble seeing
this racing season through
to the end either. Now
relax and enjoy
your time home!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Trainer, let's go all out this year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We promise to stay strong until the very
end this
year, just like we did with the
medley, and spend
the rest of our time
relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, "Mother, I Am the Ocean"! This
one covers
an immense range of notes!
All right, let's get
started!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I aaaaam the ocean! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Swallow all your sorrows! ♪ Overcome
every
mountain! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And live ooon! ♪

text_block_list.name: Top Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you two were fantastic! That was a

positively majestic performance.

text_block_list.name: Top Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Go out there and show your father just
how firmly
you'll both stand in the face
of your challenges
this year!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's get ready to make waves
even
bigger than the ocean this year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The new year ignites the burning spirit in
our
hearts, and we're ready to take any
challenge
head-on!
